effort: none: qwen 0.28.4 has no effort flag or variable; its only effort setting is model.reasoningEffort in settings.json, which each provider clamps or drops per model (packages/cli/src/config/settingsSchema.ts)
login: qwen's own login: Qwen OAuth in ~/.qwen/oauth_creds.json, or an API key provider in ~/.qwen/settings.json or ~/.qwen/.env, set up with /auth in an interactive qwen
